    def longest_palindromic_subsequence(s: str) -> int:

                elif s[i - 1] == s[n - j]:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 2
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])

        # The length of the longest palindromic subsequence
        return dp[n][n]

    return longest_palindromic_subsequence(s)
